edges.reason: msg.sender is read and returned by the _msgSender helper.
The caller identity (msg.sender via _msgSender) is used as the source of every batch transfer in transferMany.
transferMany calls _transfer inside a loop, each call invoking the overridable _beforeTokenTransfer hook.
_transfer invokes the virtual _beforeTokenTransfer hook before balances are updated, an external-call hook point.
_transfer reads and writes the _balances mapping for sender and recipient.
The LoveCoin constructor calls _mint to create the initial supply.
_mint credits the recipient balance in _balances.
_mint increases the _totalSupply state variable.
transfer forwards _msgSender(), recipient and amount to _transfer.
transferFrom moves tokens by calling _transfer.
transferFrom reduces the caller allowance by calling _approve.
increaseAllowance writes the new allowance through _approve.
decreaseAllowance writes the new allowance through _approve.
approve writes the allowance through _approve.
_approve writes the _allowances mapping.
balanceOf reads the _balances mapping.
allowance reads the _allowances mapping.
totalSupply returns the _totalSupply state variable.
transferMany contains the unbounded loop flagged as an unsafe operation.
Each loop iteration re-invokes _transfer, duplicating the state mutation and hook-call path.
_transfer reaches the unsafe operation where the hook executes before the balance state updates.
The recipients array parameter drives the loop and each _transfer destination.
The values array parameter supplies each transfer amount.
The loop counter i indexes both recipients and values inside transferMany.
The sender parameter indexes _balances in _transfer.
The recipient parameter receives the transferred balance in _transfer.
The amount parameter is subtracted/added to balances in _transfer.
The account parameter is credited with minted tokens in _mint.
The spender parameter is forwarded to _approve by approve.
The amount parameter is forwarded to _approve by approve.
